title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Strictly Enforcing the System of Case Trial Time Limits

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Reply on Issues Concerning the Implementation of the 'Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Strictly Enforcing the System of Case Adjudication Periods'
Fa Han [2001] No. 46
Higher People's Court of Jiangsu Province:
The Petition of Your Court, Su Li Han Zi No. 10, 'Request for Instructions on Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Strictly Enforcing the System of Case Adjudication Periods', has been received and reviewed. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
If the Case Filing Division undertakes pre-trial procedural work such as service of relevant legal documents, review of objections to jurisdiction, preservation of actions, and pre-trial exchange of evidence, the time limit for transferring case files to the Adjudication Division shall not be subject to the restriction set forth in Article 7 of the 'Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Strictly Enforcing the System of Case Adjudication Periods' (hereinafter referred to as the 'Several Provisions') that 'the case filing institution shall transfer the case file materials to the adjudication division within three days of deciding to file the case.' However, the time limit for transferring case files for first-instance cases shall not exceed twenty days at most, and for second-instance cases shall not exceed fifteen days at most.
If the Case Filing Division does not undertake the above-mentioned procedural work, it shall still comply with the provisions of Article 7 of the 'Several Provisions.'
August 20, 2001
